release_notes: v1.3.3: Fixed RFID auth-cache bug (writes followed by reads now work reliably). Fixed color-preservation bug (rewriting a tag to a different color now actually changes the color, not just the swatch label). Added /api/check-update proxy endpoint so the dashboard's Check for Updates no longer fails with 'unreachable' due to Chrome's mixed-content blocking on local networks. Added [AUTH] diagnostic logging for easier troubleshooting.
